hooks.name: Build — Kiro Power
hooks.description: User-triggered hook that builds the Kiro Power output from /src content.

action.prompt: The user has triggered a build. Load workflows.md and execute the build-power workflow. Follow all phases: validate source, documentation sync, version prompt, archive previous build, generate Kiro Power output, run build validation, and finalize. Stop and report if any phase fails. Ask for version type (major/minor/patch) during the version phase.
